rule: At the start of every task, evaluate the task against the parameters below, then load ONLY the skills whose triggers match your evaluation. Never load all skills.

parameters.name: task_kind
parameters.description: What kind of testing task is this?

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: How rigorous must the verification be?

skills.purpose: Drive development with tests; prove code works.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is write_tests or when verifying a feature built test-first.

skills.purpose: Playwright interaction toolkit: click, forms, screenshots, logs.
skills.triggers: Load when target is web and you need to interact with the app to verify it.

skills.purpose: Real-browser DOM inspection, console errors, network analysis.
skills.triggers: Load when target is web and you must inspect DOM/console/network or verify runtime behavior.

skills.purpose: Systematic root-cause debugging of failing tests.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is debug_failure (a test fails or behavior doesn't match).

skills.purpose: Structured diagnosis loop for hard bugs.
skills.triggers: Load when chasing a hard bug across the app.
Load when task_kind is review or when judging whether merged code is solid.

skills.purpose: Prevent truncation/placeholder output in large test files.
skills.triggers: Load when writing a large test file/suite that risks truncation.

skills.purpose: Husky/lint-staged hooks so tests run automatically on commit.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is setup and the repo lacks pre-commit test hooks.
